prompt: In system-test mode the text-to-speech stub returns headerless zeros labelled as WAV, which the MP3 re-encode cannot read, so the device integration harness has to pay for real speech synthesis. Make the stub return a valid WAV file instead: a sine tone whose length comes from a system-test setting for the number of seconds. The output must be byte-identical every time for the same length, so runs can be compared frame for frame. Real synthesis must still be used whenever system-test mode is off.
